title: Implicit elimination of unit-twisted formal monoid variables
statement:
Let $(D,\mathfrak n)$ be a nonzero complete Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and let $S,T$ be fine saturated monoids [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] which are sharp, meaning that $0$ is the only invertible element of each. Let $ eta:S	o T$ be a homomorphism with $ eta^{-1}(0)=\{0\}$. For such a sharp monoid $P$, write $D[[P]]$ for the completion of the monoid ring $D[P]$, with basis $[p]$ and multiplication $[p][p']=[p+p']$, at $(\mathfrak n,[p]:p
e0)$. Put $H=D[[S\oplus T]]$, and denote its $S$- and $T$-monomials by $X^s$ and $Y^t$. Let $u:S	o D[[S]]^	imes$ be a homomorphism to the multiplicative group of units. Let $I$ be the ideal of $H$ generated by $X^s-u(s)Y^{ eta(s)}$ for $s\in S$. The map $D[[T]]	o H/I$ induced by coefficients and $Y$-monomials is a continuous isomorphism. Its inverse sends every $X^s$ with $s
e0$ into the ideal $(Y^t:t
e0)$, and induces the identity on $D$ after killing all nonzero $T$-monomials.
